Subject: Important recall notice: Corvane children’s ibuprofen dosing syringes

We’re sharing an important safety notice about Corvane Pediatric Ibuprofen Oral Suspension, 100 mg/5 mL, berry, 120 mL bottles.

The recall applies only to bottles from lots CV6114A and CV6114B. Check the lot number on the bottom of the box before using the product. The supplied syringe in these lots has a printing error: each marking indicates half the volume it actually measures. For example, the mark labelled 2.5 mL measures 5 mL, and the mark labelled 5 mL measures 10 mL. Following the syringe markings can result in giving about twice the intended dose.

The ibuprofen suspension itself is not affected by the recall. It is not contaminated, meets specifications, and expires 08/2027. The issue is the syringe supplied in the box.

If you have one of these lots, stop using the supplied syringe and do not use it to measure another dose. Cedarbrook has replacement, correctly marked oral syringes available free of charge, with no receipt needed. We expect them today before noon. You can also bring the product in for a refund under the product recall, or come in for an exchange. We’ll be open Saturday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. for exchanges.

If your child may have received a dose measured with the recalled syringe, or you are unsure how much they received, call the Ontario Poison Centre at 1-800-268-9017. Please call even if your child seems well: the Poison Centre can assess the situation based on your child’s weight, the amount and timing of doses, and other health factors. Do not give another dose until a poison centre specialist or doctor says it is okay. Call 911 or go to the emergency department if your child is very sleepy or hard to wake, is vomiting blood, is not peeing, or has a seizure.

We understand this notice may be worrying. Please share it with anyone who may have this product at home. Check the lot number first, and contact the Poison Centre or your doctor for advice about a child’s dose or symptoms.
